name: Fill the Frame
description: Shows a picture or clip of any shape whole, over a blurred, darkened copy of itself that fills the frame, instead of black bars.

controls.name: Media
controls.description: The picture or clip, any shape; shown whole, fitted inside the frame.

controls.name: Blur
controls.description: Blurriness of the copy behind it.

controls.name: Darken
controls.description: How much darker the copy is, from 0 (as it is) to 100 (near black).

controls.name: Duration
controls.description: Length of the rendered clip in seconds, up to 60. A shorter clip plays again from the start until then.

controls.name: Clip Length
controls.description: The clip's exact length in seconds, so it loops without a held frame; tools/render.py fills it from ffprobe. 0: use the length EffectCraft reads (often one frame long).
